correctness.rationale: For X=Bl_{p1..p5} P2 over C with exactly p1,p2,p3 collinear, adjunction plus nef and big anticanonical class and Cauchy–Schwarz constrain irreducible negative curves to five exceptional E_i, seven ordinary two-point lines L_i4/L_i5/L_45, and the unique (-2)-triple line R. The conic through five points cannot be irreducible because three are collinear. A support of disjoint (-1) curves is negative definite, and if it contains R at most one chosen (-1) curve meeting R is allowed by Schur complement -2+k<0. Exhaustive independent rational 13x13 intersection-matrix Schur elimination across 8192 subsets gives no-R coefficients 1,12,46,72,43,4 and R-containing 0,1,12,40,44,10: total 285. Bauer–Schmitz finite-volume criterion places all and only the 107 R-containing supports in the infinite-volume category. Exhaustive matrix checks do not prove curve-list completeness; geometric adjunction/intersection proof supplies that premise.
